 The latest injury update for Houston Texans running back David Montgomery in Week 10 against the Cleveland Browns. Peter Dewey | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Houston Texans running back David Montgomery. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Houston Texans Houston Texans veteran running back David Montgomery has not played since Week 5 due to a groin injury, and he's once again been ruled out. 
--> Houston Texans veteran running back David Montgomery has not played since Week 5 due to a groin injury, and he's once again been ruled out. 
 Montgomery was initially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns, but the team downgraded him to out on Saturday. That puts Woody Marks in line to lead the Houston backfield once again in Week 10. 
--> Montgomery was initially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns, but the team downgraded him to out on Saturday. That puts Woody Marks in line to lead the Houston backfield once again in Week 10. 
 Texans ruled out RB David Montgomery for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to a groin injury.
— Adam Schefter (@AdamSchefter) November 14, 2026 Houston acquired Montgomery in a trade with the Detroit Lions in the offseason, and the veteran back had a huge showing in Week 1, handling 20 carries and scoring three total touchdowns.
--> Houston acquired Montgomery in a trade with the Detroit Lions in the offseason, and the veteran back had a huge showing in Week 1, handling 20 carries and scoring three total touchdowns.
 He has struggled since then, averaging just 2.7 yards per carry for the season. Overall, Montgomery has 52 carries for 138 yards and two scores to go along with seven catches for 67 yards and a score.
--> He has struggled since then, averaging just 2.7 yards per carry for the season. Overall, Montgomery has 52 carries for 138 yards and two scores to go along with seven catches for 67 yards and a score.
 Marks has filled in nicely for Montgomery, carrying the ball 15 or more times in each of the last three games. Still, he's averaging less than 4.0 yards per carry, and the Houston running game ranks 30th in yards per carry and 29th in total rushing yards this season.
--> Marks has filled in nicely for Montgomery, carrying the ball 15 or more times in each of the last three games. Still, he's averaging less than 4.0 yards per carry, and the Houston running game ranks 30th in yards per carry and 29th in total rushing yards this season.
 Montgomery appears to be getting closer to a return, but he'll have to wait until Week 11 after being ruled out.

--> Nico Collins started the season with a touchdown in Week 1 before going down with an injury, then returned with a pair of scores in Week 4. He went his next three games without a touchdown before hauling in a 13-yard score last week.
